lensFocus.spec: This branch implements docs/plans/2026-11-01-operator-ui.md. Check new §2.13 against the handlers and opapi JSON, Max's verdict in .scratch/vecnet/issues/18-operator-ui.md, that the dashboard performs no writes, that presence and reachability stay two signals with unknown never shown as offline, and §16.4 Blocked against ClaimDue. Every paused_reason must map to a paused health, and Resume must appear only for delivery_failed and operator.
lensFocus.security: Bodies, names, titles, options and file names are untrusted. Web: no HTML sink anywhere, no inline script or style, CSP unchanged, the secret only in Authorization and localStorage, never in a URL or a blob link. TUI: every peer string passes Clean or CleanBody before lipgloss; file saves stay inside the working directory and never overwrite. Admin reads are operator-only and return route and callback hosts only, no key, path or whsec. The demo controls (/__demo/*) exist only in internal/opseed/demo and can never reach the vecnet-hub binary.
lensFocus.tests: Check that Playwright and tmux scripts wait on state rather than time, that they always kill their hub and browser, that they never bind 45752 or 49575, that SHOTS_DIR is honoured, that goldens were read and not blindly regenerated, that the Go and JS tag tests really load one fixture, and that each named assertion in the plan exists.

extraLenses.title: Visual and interaction design
extraLenses.focus: You judge what it looks and feels like as one product, because thirteen separate agents built its screens. Read every PNG in docs/plans/shots/oui/ with the Read tool, beside docs/prototypes/operator-ui/shots/ (a-*.png for web, b-chat.png for the side panel and matrix, c-*.png for the TUI) and Max's verdict in .scratch/vecnet/issues/18-operator-ui.md. Find inconsistency across screens: spacing, type scale, colours for the same state, button and chip styles, empty and error states, and copy tone. Find clipped, overlapping or misaligned text, weak hierarchy, and anything that fights the Global Constraints palette. For the TUI, check alignment, colour use and legibility. Boot the demo with scripts/ui/lib.mjs if a shot leaves a question open, writing any screenshot to a SHOTS_DIR under the status directory. A defect a person would notice on first use is major; a preference is minor. Name file and selector or screen for every finding.
